latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of openclaw-video: AI-powered video editing for quick, high-quality 1080p exports from raw footage.
- Upload raw video (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, image/audio formats) and describe the desired edit; no manual timeline or export settings needed.
- Authentication automatically handled on first run via free, 7-day NEMO_TOKEN (100 credits); all processing happens securely on remote GPU nodes.
- Key features: instant trimming, automated silence detection, background music, text overlays, rapid cloud rendering (usually 30–90 seconds).
- Clear, guided workflows for uploading, editing, previewing, and exporting video content; concise error handling and status feedback.
- Credits and session management integrated; supports registered and anonymous usage.
